comparative_hypothesis: Web developers sometimes need to remove a small client site from a builder and use manual rebuild or a service alternative.
external_evidence_summary: Independent practitioner account describes the job and manual workaround.
private_evidence_needed: More user-side cases across the same role/context.

comparative_hypothesis: Independent web developers handling small client handoffs have this job in a repeatable context.
minimum_evidence_needed: Repeated role/context and route to similar people.

comparative_hypothesis: Developers/clients may pay for lower-risk handoff rather than spend manual rebuild time.
external_evidence_summary: Service alternative publishes a project price.
contradiction_or_risk: Competitor price does not prove object WTP.

comparative_hypothesis: ExportKit must transfer a site with lower effort/risk than manual rebuild or a migration service.
external_evidence_summary: External friction with manual alternative is documented, but no independent object outcome exists.
contradiction_or_risk: Feature parity may not create a usable outcome.
minimum_evidence_needed: Observed object outcome compared with alternative.

comparative_hypothesis: The object can reach developers where they already seek builder/migration alternatives.
external_evidence_summary: Alternative category and practitioner discussion show a discoverable context.
contradiction_or_risk: Competitor discovery route may not transfer.

comparative_hypothesis: Object delivery can fit a market price unit while covering internal cost.
external_evidence_summary: Market has a fixed-price service alternative.
private_evidence_needed: Payments, support hours and sale cost.
contradiction_or_risk: Market unit does not prove object margin.

comparative_hypothesis: Object can sustain differentiated outcome over several cases.
external_evidence_summary: No external repeated object outcome is available.
private_evidence_needed: Repeat use, outcomes and stable cost/quality.
